description: This file provides utility functions for interacting with a notes API, including fetching the API base URL, creating new notes, and listing notes with optional filters.
external_files: process.env (environment variables in Node.js environment or bundled via build tools)

methods.name: getApiBase()
methods.description: Returns the configured API base URL, which is derived from environment variable REACT_APP_API_URL or defaults to 'http://localhost:3001'.

methods.name: createNote(body)
methods.description: Creates a new note by posting data to the API endpoint '/api/notes'. Accepts a body object with optional 'title', 'content', and 'tag_ids'.

methods.name: listNotes(params = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notes from the API, with optional query parameters for filtering such as search, tag, pinned, archived, or trashed.
